test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language if SUNSET is written as TVOTFU, how will SUNRISE be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series. 

So,

 
• SUNSET is written as TVOTFU

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83ccaff07d970153ef88bdf45496b03f25aa82cc72c54cab0e3772ea5db131a6.png] 

​Similarly, 

 
• SUNRISE is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9fc91ad2c3495713537401e104376c715157fcc86af06afe53674e00437137eb.png] 

​Hence, "**TVOSJTF**" is the correct answer.

83:T
